findings.summary: AC-dm-43 and AC-dm-50 runtime evidence (tests/e2e/shell.spec.ts: FitPulse visible, never V-Stage, no password field, document.fonts.check for Inter and JetBrains Mono, external requests blocked) cannot run in this unit: the spec, playwright.config.ts and the backend process belong to other units/integration.
Play dev-link (Settings -> Instalar App -> Linkar pasta) showing the shell with a green badge needs the Play desktop and the backend lane; not runnable here.

src/App.tsx routes #/empresas, #/empresa/:companyId, #/diagnostico/:diagnosisId and #/resultado/:diagnosisId render a PendingScreen (data-state="pending", 'Esta tela ainda está sendo preparada.') until the companies/questionnaire/result units replace each route element; '/' redirects to #/empresas and unknown routes show NotFoundScreen.

The theme toggle and tour buttons of the prototype top bar are not in AppShell: theme persistence (preferences) and the tour belong to Phase 3 units. The shell ships brand 'FitPulse', nav (Empresas), main region and the 'Pular para o conteúdo' skip link.

evidence.summary: tsc --noEmit && vite build succeeded (TS 7.0.2, Vite 8.3.5); dist/assets/index-*.css 59 kB, index-*.js 291 kB.

dist/assets has inter-latin-{400,500,600,700}-normal-*.woff2 and jetbrains-mono-latin-{400,500}-normal-*.woff2 (plus other subsets), 40 @font-face rules with families Inter and JetBrains Mono, 0 external url() in CSS, 0 external href/src in dist/index.html. JS only contains non-fetched URL strings (react.dev error docs text, XML namespaces, reactrouter.com warning text). No default Tailwind blue palette in CSS (--color-* reset).

vite preview with PORT=5791 served http://127.0.0.1:5791/ with <title>FitPulse</title> and /assets/inter-latin-400-normal-*.woff2 as 200 font/woff2. The probe process exited 127 from a libuv assertion at Node shutdown on Windows after the result was printed (result ok=true); the Host-header sub-probe is not evidence (fetch cannot override Host).

messages.text: vite.config.ts proxies /api to http://127.0.0.1:${BACKEND_PORT||3301} with changeOrigin=false, so requests reach the backend with the browser's Host (127.0.0.1:PORT or localhost:PORT). server/http/requestGuards.ts must accept 127.0.0.1/localhost on PORT as well as BACKEND_PORT, or every proxied call gets 403. Server and preview both bind 127.0.0.1 with strictPort.

Remaining checks for CAP-dm-play-runtime shell: run `pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/shell.spec.ts` once playwright.config.ts, fixtures and backend exist (expects 'FitPulse' in the header, no 'V-Stage', no password input, document.fonts.check('16px Inter') and ('16px "JetBrains Mono"')), then dev-link in the Play.

Tokens (src/styles/tokens.css) use English names: --ground, --ground-sunken, --surface, --surface-raised, --solid, --text, --text-soft, --text-muted, --line, --line-strong, --bronze(-contrast), --gold(-contrast), --patina, --copper, --peril(-contrast), --scrim, --accent, --wash, --ok/--warn/--danger(+ -wash), --focus-ring, --font-structure/-human/-machine, --t-*, --r-*, --control (40px), --touch (44px), --ease/--fast/--dur. Theme: :root = ink (dark), :root[data-theme="light"] = porcelain. Tailwind utilities from @theme inline: bg-ground, bg-surface, bg-surface-raised, text-text, text-text-soft, text-text-muted, border-line, border-line-strong, bg-bronze, text-bronze-contrast, bg-gold, bg-danger, text-danger-contrast, bg-wash, text-ok/warn/danger, bg-scrim, font-sans/serif/mono, rounded-sm/md/lg, ease-app; plus utilities voice-human and meta-line. The default Tailwind color palette and all shadows are reset (no blue-*, gray-*, shadow-*): use tokens and borders.

src/components/ui/button.tsx exports Button and buttonVariants with variant: default (neutral outline) | metal (bronze, main action) | gate (gold, gates only) | destructive | ghost | link, size: default | sm | lg | icon (44px touch target under 640px), asChild via @radix-ui/react-slot, type defaults to 'button'. AppShell wraps the routes in src/App.tsx; replace each PendingScreen element there with the real page (companies: empresas, empresa/:companyId; questionnaire: diagnostico/:diagnosisId; result: resultado/:diagnosisId). HashRouter/Link/NavLink come from 'react-router' v7.
